Senate Passes Measure Designed to Speed Up Energy Projects, Lower Consumer Costs

Bipartisan effort to streamline federal permitting split Democrats over environmental concerns

By

and

The Senate passed a bipartisan bill Thursday evening designed to speed up energy, mining and other infrastructure projects, overcoming concerns among many Democrats that it would weaken environmental protection laws.

The vote was 62 to 33, with 14 Democrats voting for the bill and two Republicans voting against it.
